title: Reach causal pending keys with TEXT or BLOB retry order during a sustained numeric backlog
outcome: A genuine original with a damaged retry-order type is eventually selected and repaired while a large numeric pending backlog remains.
acceptance: A disposable regression with at least32 numeric pending keys and a genuine original whose retry order is TEXT or BLOB proves bounded selection, repair and exact settlement of that original.
Selection stays bounded and indexed while preserving original custody, metadata bytes, current authority checks and healthy-key progress.
